question: X, Y and Z are three equilateral triangles. The sum of the areas of X and Y is equal to the area of Z. If the side lengths of X and Y are 6 cm and 8 cm respectively, then what is the side length of Z?
solution:
Given: 

X, Y and Z are three equilateral triangles.

The side of X = 6 cm

The side of Y = 8 cm

Concept used:

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3)/({4)}a2

Calculation:

Area of equilateral triangle = (√3)/({4)}a2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a3f67ba545c1c6e8a22e592d38e614e554264a942cbe2bcb143e1eff16716ab.png] 

According to the question

AX + AY = AZ

⇒ ((√3)/({4)} × 62) + ((√3)/({4)} × 82) = ((sqrt3)/({4)} × x2)

⇒ 36 + 64 = x2

⇒ 100 = x2

⇒ x = 10

∴ The side length of Z is 10 cm.
